label: Fates
tooltip: Settings for FATE automation and pot chest farming.

should_do_fates.label: Do FATEs
should_do_fates.tooltip: Allow Illegal Mode to select and run FATE goals.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Boost scoring for Persistent Pots and Pleading Pots when choosing a FATE.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Preposition to pots before spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip: When pot farming is enabled, leave early (spawn lead + FATE cutoff) and wait near the predicted north/south pot spot with a random stand-off. Requires observing one pot FATE first to learn the cycle.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Min pot FATE time remaining (minutes)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Do not path to (or stay on) a pot FATE with fewer minutes left than this. Set to 0 to disable.

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Pot spawn lead (minutes)
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: Minutes before the predicted pot spawn to leave for pots. Used with FATE/CE cutoffs and preposition.

fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: FATE cutoff before pot departure (minutes)
fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a non-pot FATE when pot departure is within this many minutes. Also starts pot preposition when enabled. Set to 0 to disable.

ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: CE cutoff before pot departure (minutes)
ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start a Critical Encounter when pot departure is within this many minutes. Set to 0 to disable.

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After completing a pot FATE, walk to linked chest positions and open them before choosing a new activity.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Include reroll pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: Also farm the shared reroll chest positions after a pot FATE.

disabled_fate_ids.label: FATE availability
disabled_fate_ids.tooltip: Uncheck a FATE to exclude it from Illegal Mode selection.
disabled_fate_ids.empty: No FATEs defined for the current zone.
